name: Curbside Eatery & Drinkery
notes: 4 photos; 1-3 are the printed two-page laminated menu (photos 1 and 2 are one version, photo 3 shows the board with a few items swapped in a later reprint, so both sets of unique items are merged); photo 4 is a wine/cocktail list only, skipped per rules.

dishes.name: Curbside Short Rib Nachos
dishes.description: Our famous braised short rib, tortilla chips, signature cheese sauce, pico de gallo, achiote charred salsa, cilantro crema, green onion, fresh sliced jalapeños, and cotija cheese.

dishes.name: Chicken Wings
dishes.description: Seven wings with your choice of ranch or blue cheese dressing on the side. Choice of House Honey & Whiskey Buffalo, Thai Chili, or BBQ.

dishes.name: Brussels Sprouts
dishes.description: Crispy Brussels sautéed in a pomegranate sauce, served with feta cheese and slivered almonds.

dishes.name: 3 Cheese Quesadilla
dishes.description: Pepper jack, American, and cheddar cheeses. Served with sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallo.

dishes.name: Firecracker Shrimp
dishes.description: Crispy hand-dipped shrimp covered in our firecracker sauce served on a bed of wasabi slaw.

dishes.name: Hummus + Chips
dishes.description: House-made hummus served with seasoned pita chips.

dishes.name: Pretzel Bites
dishes.description: Served with our signature cheese sauce and dijon beer mustard.

dishes.name: Loaded Fries
dishes.description: Our famous fries, mom's taco meat, nacho cheese, green onion, chipotle crema, and cotija cheese.

dishes.name: Poke Nachos
dishes.description: Yellowfin tuna, wonton chips, avocado, green onion, wasabi crema, sriracha aioli, sliced jalapeños, carrot strips, seaweed salad, and sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Gyro Fries
dishes.description: Our famous fries with gyro meat, tzatziki, feta cheese, and parsley.

dishes.name: Side of Fries
dishes.description: Garlic, Parmesan, OR White Truffle +2.

dishes.name: Cauli or Onion or Squash
dishes.description: Hand-dipped, panko-crusted cauliflower, onion rings, or squash. Topped with Parmesan and parsley. Served with Thai chili, ketchup, or ranch.

dishes.name: "B & B" Fries
dishes.description: Our famous fries topped with blue cheese and a balsamic glaze.

dishes.name: Dinner Salad
dishes.description: Mixed greens, tomato, cucumber, red onion, choice of dressings.

dishes.name: Taco Salad
dishes.description: Locally sourced seasoned ground Angus, mixed greens, tortilla strips, cheddar cheese, avocado, garbanzo beans, and pico de gallo served with our cilantro crema.

dishes.name: Greek Salad
dishes.description: Chopped romaine, kalamata olives, cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, red onions, and cucumbers served with lemon dressing.

dishes.name: Berry Salad
dishes.description: Mixed greens, fresh berries, feta cheese, glazed pecans, and dressed with champagne vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Citrus Salad
dishes.description: A variety of sliced oranges & tangerines and grapefruit, served with mint.

dishes.name: Ahi Poke Salad or Bowl
dishes.description: Yellowfin tuna, mixed greens or rice, edamame beans, shredded carrots, avocado, cucumbers, green onions, seaweed salad, crispy wontons, and toasted sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Caesar Salad
dishes.description: Chopped romaine, shaved Parmesan cheese, house croutons, tossed in house-made Caesar dressing.

dishes.name: Garbanzo & Veggie Delight
dishes.description: Beans with english cucumber, tomato, red onion, shredded carrots, celery, and parsley tossed with our red wine Italian vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Tri-Color Quinoa Salad
dishes.description: Freshly roasted seasonal vegetables, seasoned to perfection, tossed in our lemon mint dressing.

dishes.name: Apple Pear Pom Salad
dishes.description: Mixed greens, pomegranate arils, feta cheese, candied pecans, and a balsamic glaze. Dressed with champagne vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Chilaquiles
dishes.description: Fresh tortilla strips, house-made red sauce, jalapeños, cilantro crema, eggs over easy, with pickled onions, and cotija cheese.

dishes.name: French Toast
dishes.description: Two slices of cinnamon swirl brioche bread French toast.

dishes.name: Breakfast Crunch
dishes.description: Toasted pita bread with hard-boiled eggs, avocado, celery, red onions, jalapeño, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Topped with cucumber and drizzled with a balsamic glaze.

dishes.name: Breakfast Sandwich
dishes.description: A scrambled egg, crispy bacon, cheddar cheese, and sliced avocado, served on a toasted English muffin.

dishes.name: Breakfast Burger
dishes.description: 1/2 lb Angus patty, cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, lettuce, tomato, dijonnaise, our bacon jam, and topped with an egg your way. Served on a toasted brioche bun.

dishes.name: Boulevard Burrito
dishes.description: Our famous short rib, two scrambled eggs, crispy bacon, avocado, house fries, pico de gallo, and cheddar cheese in a grilled flour tortilla. Served with jalapeño crema.

dishes.name: Basic Breakfast
dishes.description: Two eggs your way, crispy bacon, house breakfast potatoes, and your choice of English muffin or sourdough bread.

dishes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
dishes.description: Plain Greek yogurt, a fresh berry medley, and slivered almonds, drizzled with an agave nectar and mint.

dishes.name: Curbside Burger
dishes.description: 1/2 lb locally sourced ground Angus patty, brie cheese, bacon jam, lettuce, tomato, and garlic aioli. Served on a toasted brioche bun.

dishes.name: Mushroom Swiss Burger
dishes.description: 1/2 lb locally sourced ground Angus patty, Swiss cheese, roasted portobello mushroom, dijonnaise, and lettuce. Served on a toasted brioche bun.

dishes.name: Spicy Burger
dishes.description: 1/2 lb locally sourced ground Angus patty, pepper jack, lettuce, grilled jalapeño mash with chipotle aioli. Served on a toasted brioche bun.

dishes.name: Basic Burger
dishes.description: 1/2 lb locally sourced ground Angus patty, sliced cheddar cheese, tomato, lettuce, and onions. Served on a toasted brioche bun.

dishes.name: Blue Cheese Burger
dishes.description: 1/2 lb locally sourced ground Angus patty, fresh blue cheese, pickled onion, mixed greens, and a balsamic glaze.

dishes.name: Angus Sliders (Three)
dishes.description: Locally sourced ground Angus, cheddar cheese, caramelized onion, and our bacon jam. Served on Hawaiian rolls.

dishes.name: "Mom's" Burrito
dishes.description: Seasoned ground Angus cooked with onions & peppers, melted cheese, lettuce, sour cream, and pico de gallo all wrapped in a flour tortilla then grilled, and served with salsa.

dishes.name: Kebab Sandwich/Wrap
dishes.description: Tomato, red onion, cucumber, and garlic aioli with your choice of protein served on freshly grilled pita bread. Steak 17, Chicken 16, Gyro 15, Shrimp 15, Falafel 14, Veggies 14.

dishes.name: Short Rib Melt
dishes.description: Braised short rib, sharp cheddar cheese, caramelized onions, and chipotle aioli. Served on toasted sourdough.

dishes.name: La Mesa Chicken
dishes.description: Marinated hormone-free chicken breast, bacon, pepper jack cheese, avocado, romaine, tomato, and dijonnaise. Served on sourdough bread.

dishes.name: Kick A** B.L.T.
dishes.description: Applewood bacon, romaine lettuce, and freshly sliced tomato with chipotle spread. Served on toasted sourdough.

dishes.name: Grilled Cheese
dishes.description: American, pepper jack, and cheddar cheese served on toasted sourdough bread.

dishes.name: Tacos - Choose 2
dishes.description: Served on a corn tortilla with chips and salsa on the side. Choose 2 of: Short Rib, "Mom's", Grilled Chicken, Firecracker Shrimp, Beer-Battered Cod, or Falafel.

dishes.name: George's Fish & Fries
dishes.description: Hand-dipped beer-battered cod. Served with our famous French fries, and wasabi slaw. Served with tartar sauce.

dishes.name: Chicken Strips & Fries
dishes.description: Three hand-dipped chicken tenders in our special seasoning. Served with our famous French fries.

dishes.name: Falafel Plate
dishes.description: Ground chickpeas mixed with herbs and spices. Served with basmati rice, fresh salad, hummus, and freshly grilled pita bread.

dishes.name: Gyros Plate
dishes.description: Carved döner kebab meat (beef & lamb), served with basmati rice, fresh salad, hummus, and freshly grilled pita bread.

dishes.name: Surf & Turf Kebab Plate
dishes.description: One skewer of charbroiled beef and one skewer of charbroiled shrimp, both with bell peppers & onions. Served with basmati rice, fresh salad, house-made hummus, and freshly grilled pita bread.

dishes.name: Beef Tika Kebab Plate
dishes.description: One skewer of charbroiled beef with bell peppers & onions.

dishes.name: Chicken Kebab Plate
dishes.description: One skewer of marinated chicken with jalapeños & onions.

dishes.name: Shrimp Kebab Plate
dishes.description: One skewer of charbroiled shrimp with bell peppers & onions.

dishes.name: Veggie Kebab Plate
dishes.description: Red potato, zucchini, squash, mushroom, bell pepper, and onion.

dishes.name: Pooch Patty
dishes.description: Three locally sourced Angus beef patties for your four-footed friend.
